title: Analista de suporte de ti
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação. No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Eko Truck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Especialista em Operações Comerciais abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso: Principais responsabilidades Atendimento e tratativa de chamados de suporte a sistemas Criação, manutenção e gestão de acessos aos sistemas Suporte funcional aos módulos de ERP Apoio aos usuários nas rotinas dos sistemas Financeiro, Contábil, Fiscal, Suprimentos, Mercado e RH Suporte às ferramentas: ERP Senior, e-Docs e Vxpenses Registro, acompanhamento e resolução de incidentes e requisições Apoio na documentação de processos e procedimentos Requisitos Experiência prévia em suporte técnico ou funcional Conhecimento básico em sistemas ERP Noções de processos nas áreas: Financeira Contábil Fiscal Suprimentos Mercado RH Vivência com abertura e acompanhamento de chamados Boa comunicação e organização Diferenciais Conhecimento em ferramentas como ERP Senior Familiaridade com gestão de acessos (perfis e permissões) Noções de ITIL ou boas práticas de atendimento Experiência com suporte remoto Vantagens/Benefícios: Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família. Refeição no local - para garantir refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia. Vale Transporte - para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa. Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama. Assistência Odontológica - cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família. Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar. Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados. Wellhub (Gympass) - incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar. Telemedicina: Dra. AON | Conexa Saúde - apoio à sua saúde com praticidade e rapidez, sempre que precisar. Parceria Open English – curso de idiomas com condições exclusivas para colaboradores. Programa de Desenvolvimento Educacional (PDE) - apoio financeiro e institucional para formações, cursos ou especializações alinhadas às suas atividades e ao desenvolvimento da empresa. Premiação anual – reconhecimento pelo seu desempenho. Petlove - plano de assistência médica para cães e gatos, cuidando da saúde do seu melhor amigo com carinho, segurança e tranquilidade. Horário de trabalho: segunda à sexta-feira, das 07h30 às 17h18. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

title: Analista de riscos e seguros júnior
description: Venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Somos uma consultoria que une inteligência de riscos e soluções em seguros com o propósito de proteger empresas e pessoas em um mundo que se renova a cada instante. Em nossa trajetória de mais de 45 anos atuando em projetos de alta complexidade, o que nos move são os desafios de nossos clientes e a convicção de que podemos atuar diretamente na transformação de incertezas em oportunidades por meio da criação de soluções sob medida, qualificadas e inovadoras. Quer nos conhecer melhor? Acesse: e saiba mais sobre nossa atuação e Nossa Cultura. Buscamos um/a Analista de Riscos e Seguros Júnior com atuação em regime híbrido na cidade do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, que terá a missão de suportar à gestão de seguros, renovação de apólices, negociação com seguradoras, análise e mitigação de riscos, apoio a sinistros, controle operacional, registros sistêmicos e colaboração integrada com equipes e mercado segurador. Na Horiens, este/a profissional será responsável terá estas atividades principais: Dar suporte e manter follow up durante a renovação de apólices dos ramos Petróleo, Responsabilidades, Transportes, Auto, entre outros, assim como na contratação de novos programas de seguros através do entendimento das necessidades dos clientes, riscos envolvidos e obrigações identificadas, por meio de negociação junto às seguradoras, prezando pela redução de taxas e melhoria de condições, bem como acompanhar o fluxo de pagamentos dos prêmios e apoiar na elaboração dos orçamentos e programações financeiras; Apoiar na regulação dos sinistros, através da interface com o cliente e organização das informações para uma comunicação clara e objetiva, com entendimento pleno do clausulado vigente, a fim de garantir os direitos de indenização, possibilitando maior eficiência na recuperação dos prejuízos indenizáveis; Apoiar na análise de riscos em novas oportunidades de negócios para os clientes, através da avaliação e revisão dos contratos de subcontratadas e fornecedores, visando minimizar potenciais perdas e exposições dos clientes, mitigando os riscos através de transferência para os seguradores/resseguradores ou por outros mecanismos contratuais, com a apresentação das respectivas soluções ao clientes, além do desenvolvimento do relacionamento junto ao mercado segurador; Apoiar no processo constante de revisão das apólices vigentes, por meio de avaliação de mercado e identificação de novos riscos, visando garantir a aderência do programa de seguros as exigências dos financiamentos estruturados e políticas corporativas; Revisar de forma detalhada e cadastrar, todas as apólices e endossos no SAS, garantindo a confiança e segurança nas informações, bem como controlar o recebimento de comissões, market share de exposições das seguradoras, cadastro de sinistros e acompanhamento da sinistralidade; Promover e estimular a boa interface entre a equipe por meio de discussões, reuniões e compartilhamento de informações, visando a manutenção de um ambiente pautado pela comunicação, respeito, cooperação e de constante busca pela inovação e conhecimento, com o objetivo de alcançar as metas estabelecidas, com qualidade nas entregas e assegurando o alinhamento com os políticas e processos. Para este desafio conosco gostaríamos do seguinte perfil: Formação Superior em Administração, Direito, Engenharia, Economia ou demais áreas correlatas; Desejável experiência no segmento de Seguros e/ou Resseguros Vivência em negociação e relacionamento com seguradoras e resseguradoras será um diferencial; Conhecimentos intermediários do Microsoft Excel e demais softwares do Pacote Office; Perfil colaborativo, curioso e com vontade de aprender. ✅ Os/As interessados/as podem se candidatar aqui, por meio desta vaga em nosso Linked In. ✅ Conhece alguém com este perfil? Compartilhe esta oportunidade. Conheça alguns dos benefícios que oferecemos para você e sua família: Jornada de trabalho flexível e em modelo híbrido (3x2); Plano de Previdência Privada para você atuar hoje no seu futuro; Programa de Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Vale Refeição; Vale Transporte ou estacionamento; Wellhub (Gympass) para promover o cuidado com a saúde; Seguro de Vida; Plano de Saúde; Outros seguros pessoais opcionais, com valores diferenciados (como seguro residencial, seguro-viagem e seguro de acidentes pessoais); Somos parte do Empresa Cidadã, programa que oferece licença estendida de maternidade (180 dias) e de paternidade (20 dias); Auxílio creche mensal (até 12 meses); Diversas parcerias e convênios que oferecem descontos em serviços e produtos. Aqui você terá espaço para desenvolvimento, autonomia e impacto real , contribuindo para fortalecer a reputação de uma empresa em constante transformação. Vem crescer com a gente na Horiens!

title: Emerging market trader - latam (brl, mxn, ars)
description: We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in LATAM currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities: FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on LATAM markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS) Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Lp partnership manager (latam)
description: We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors. depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties Market & Network Development Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

description: We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties Market & Network Development Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Business development specialist
description: As a Business Development Specialist, you will play an integral part in growing Penumbra in Latin America by supporting the Country Manager of Brazil in developing downstream strategy and execution initiatives across multiple regions. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting Penumbra’s growth in their assigned regions(the states of Rio de Janeiro & Espirito Santo) by working closely with regional distributors to execute field medical visits, organize and operationalize hands-on sessions, workshops, and product training programs. This role will be 100% focused on fieldwork, ensuring that Penumbra’s technologies are effectively introduced, demonstrated, and adopted by healthcare professionals through our distributor network. What You’ll Work On • Conduct field medical visits in collaboration with distributors, ensuring consistent education and awareness of Penumbra products. • Plan, organize, and operationalize hands-on sessions, workshops, and in-hospital product training for distributors and healthcare professionals. • Act as the primary field of support for distributor activities, ensuring alignment with Penumbra’s commercial and clinical strategies. • Support the implementation of product launches in your assigned region by working directly with distributors to drive product adoption and penetration in key accounts. • Gather and report market intelligence from the field to the Country Manager, identifying opportunities, challenges, and competitive movements. • Maintain effective communication and partnership with distributors to ensure consistency in messaging, training, and execution. • Select, manage, train, and develop staff. Establish objectives and assignments and provide ongoing feedback through performance reviews and development plans. What You Contribute • A Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related field with 3+ years of experience in Medical Devices (Sales, Clinical Support, or Training roles), preferably with exposure to field education and product demonstrations. Additional qualifications: • In-depth knowledge of the healthcare market and medical device industry in the region. • Experience conducting workshops, training, or hands-on product demonstrations in hospitals and with distributors. • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously. • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging physicians, nurses, and distributor teams. • High degree of ownership, accuracy, and attention to detail. • Ability to travel extensively across your assigned region (up to 70%). • English proficiency is preferred. Working Conditions General office, laboratory, cleanroom, and hospital environments. Willingness and ability to work on site. May have business travel from 50% - 70%. Potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens and other potentially infectious materials. Requires some lifting and moving of up to 25 pounds. Ability to wear 7-9 pounds of lead for extended periods of time. Occasional on-call availability required 24 hours per day, 7 days per week. Must be able to move between buildings and floors. Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day. Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets. Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed. Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.

title: Finance professional - fp&a operations
description: Partner with the best The Cost Controller is a key part of the Project Finance team for the Subsea Project & Services business. The role provides financial reporting and analysis to the project execution team and other stakeholders including the Project Finance Manager. In the role you will be part of a global team of project cost controllers and be responsible for budget management across a number of projects. The role will involve daily use of the SP&S Oracle ERP system, the successful candidate will quickly acquire the ability to analyse, understand and simply explain financial transactions to financial and non-financial stakeholders. The role will take on the budget responsibility and financial control of subsea projects where, together with the project manager, you will be responsible for reporting the total estimated cost of the project to the product line leadership team. You will also be responsible for forecasting project spend profiles, reporting any variances in expected total project cost and driving business decisions to optimise the financial performance of the assigned projects. As a Finance Professional – FP&A Operations, you will be responsible for: Project cost control for a portfolio of projects/scopes. Managing the impact of change orders and identifying and reporting changes in expected costs for a defined project scope. Quarterly forecasting of spend profile across projects, reflecting project execution in line with the project and manufacturing plans. Quarterly Project Cost Review (PCR) to validate total project cost to wider SPS management team. Overall management of cost budgets within Oracle ERP. Reporting of any quarterly volume variance through to SP&S QMI rhythms Support the SPS cash collection effort by maintaining project focus on timely achievement of project cash milestones. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role you will have: Strong Academic background and or university graduate with minimum 2:1 in a finance/economics related degree (or equivalent degree with demonstrable finance work experience). Advanced English Level. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and willingness to learn quickly. Strong work ethic. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills and an effective team player. Effective written and oral communication skills. Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment and attention to detail Ability to influence others. Commitment to HSE, integrity and compliance priorities. Special challenges: Communicate clearly and professionally with finance and non-finance professionals within the organisation. Be responsive and resilient to support evolving business demands in a dynamic operating environment. Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and how people want to work and deliver at their best can vary. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole, authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. Working for you Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. To keep moving forward, we push boundaries today and prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their contributions. Join us and you can expect: Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities. Comprehensive private medical care options. Safety net of life insurance and disability programs. PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES Desenvolver iniciativas de automação e integração, incluindo o uso de inteligência artificial aplicada às rotinas de compliance; Atuar no recebimento, análise e consolidação de dados e indicadores de Compliance; Elaborar dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas; Contribuir parao fortalecimento e a evolução do Programa de Compliance do Grupo; Promover ações de conscientização sobre ética e princípios de Compliance; Apoiar os processos de apuração de denúncias; Dar suporte a auditorias e processos de conformidade nas empresas do Grupo. REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS Conhecimento avançado em Power BI, Power Query, Power Platform e Office 365; Experiência comautomação de processos e desenvolvimento de soluções; Certificações em Power Apps, Power Query e Power BI; Formação superior em Administração, Economia ou Contabilidade; Experiência sólida em Compliance, Auditoria, Governança, Riscos e Controles Internos; Vivência em processos de apuração de denúncias. DIFERENCIAL Conhecimento em SQL e Power Automate PRO; Vivência em ambientes ERP e participação em projetos de inovação em Compliance; Certificações CCEP, CFE, CPC-A e ISO 37001 / ISO 37301; Local: Ramos - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

title: Analista fiscal pleno
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). Dentro desse ecossistema de soluções, a Equipo Locadora é especialista em soluções personalizadas para empresas que precisam de transporte sem complicações, oferecendo tecnologia, gestão inteligente de frota e atendimento próximo aos clientes. Com o objetivo de oferecer transporte inteligente e eficiente para empresas de diferentes portes e segmentos, sempre com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e inovação. No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Eko Truck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Sua missão: Garantir a correta apuração e cumprimento das obrigações fiscais da empresa. Assegurando conformidade com a legislação tributária vigente. Redução de riscos fiscais e suporte estratégico às áreas internas, por meio de análises, controles. Acompanhamento das rotinas tributárias e acessórias. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis. Sólidos conhecimentos fiscais: fechamento fiscal, retenção e apuração de impostos indiretos (estaduais) IPI, INSS, ICMS, ISS, PIS e COFINS. Conhecimentos em EFD e SPED Fiscal. Conhecimentos sobre a transição da reforma tributária será um diferencial. Excel intermediário a avançado. Local de trabalho: Pavuna/RJ Horário de trabalho: segunda à sexta-feira, das 07:30 às 17:18. Vantagens/Benefícios: Ticket Alimentação - pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família. Assistência Médica - cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama. Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral - proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados. Telemedicina: Dra. AON | Conexa Saúde - apoio à sua saúde com praticidade e rapidez, sempre que precisar. Programa de Desenvolvimento Educacional (PDE) - apoio financeiro e institucional para formações, cursos ou especializações alinhadas às suas atividades e ao desenvolvimento da empresa. Petlove - plano de assistência médica para cães e gatos, cuidando da saúde do seu melhor amigo com carinho, segurança e tranquilidade. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

title: Terapeuta vendedora
description: Descrição da Empresa Caudalie é uma marca francesa de cuidados com a pele fundada por Mathilde e Bertrand Thomas em Bordeaux, em 1995. Todos os seus produtos são desenvolvidos com ingredientes naturais derivados da uva e da videira. A missão da Caudalie é ser a marca de beleza mais eficaz, natural e sustentável do mercado, priorizando o respeito ao meio ambiente. Com paixão e inovação, a empresa busca oferecer soluções de cuidados com a pele que unem resultados e compromisso com a natureza. Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de uma Terapeuta Vendedora para integrar nossa equipe no Rio de janeiro. Entre as responsabilidades do cargo estão realizar atendimentos personalizados aos clientes, aplicar tratamentos faciais e corporais, oferecer consultoria sobre produtos e promover a experiência única da marca. Além disso, a profissional será responsável por atingir metas de vendas e colaborar com a organização do espaço. Este é um cargo presencial e de dedicação integral. Qualificações Atendimento ao Cliente e Vendas: Experiência em vendas, habilidade em consultoria personalizada e orientação ao cliente para oferecer soluções adequadas às suas necessidades. Estética e Cuidados pessoais: Conhecimento em técnicas de cuidados com a pele e aplicação de tratamentos faciais e corporais. Habilidades de Comunicação: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficaz, garantindo uma excelente experiência ao cliente. Atitudes e Diferenciais: Perfil proativo e organizado, paixão por produtos naturais e cuidados com a pele; será considerado um diferencial ter formação em estética ou áreas afins e conhecimento de línguas estrangeiras.

title: Remote rezeption & gästeservice (m/w/d)

B. Booking. Com) Englisch oder Portugiesisch als Zusatzvorteil Rahmenbedingungen Remote-Position (Brasilien), idealerweise in Rio de Janeiro Vollzeit (oder Teilzeit nach Absprache) Start: so bald wie möglich Bewerbung Bitte bewirb dich direkt über Linked In mit Lebenslauf auf Deutsch (!) und einem kurzen Satz, warum du gut zu dieser Rolle passt. Deutsch ist für diese Position zwingend. Bitte antworte auf Deutsch auf diese 3 Fragen: Wo wohnst du aktuell? Wann kannst du anfangen? Ein Gast schreibt: „Wir kommen heute später an. Können wir trotzdem einchecken?“ – Was antwortest du?

title: Pesquisador(a) associado(a)
description: (ATENÇÃO: a vaga permanece aberta até 22/maio/2026 e candidaturas serão avaliadas continuamente até esse prazo. Somente candidaturas enviadas por email com os documentos solicitados no anúncio serão consideradas - favor não usar a ferramenta 'Easy Apply' do Linked In). O Centro de Energia, Finanças e Desenvolvimento (CEFD) é um think tank que atua na agenda de transição energética e diversificação econômica de países produtores de petróleo na América Latina e na África. O Centro reúne pesquisadores e formuladores de políticas para propor soluções práticas que conciliem prosperidade socioeconômica e sustentabilidade. Mais informações podem ser encontradas em Dentro da expansão de sua área de pesquisa, o CEFD abre uma vaga para Pesquisador(a) Associado(a). Principais temas de pesquisa: - Transição energética e seus impactos econômicos e institucionais; - Financiamento da transição energética e finanças climáticas; - Estratégias de desenvolvimento e diversificação econômica em países dependentes de combustíveis fósseis; - Governança e instrumentos de política para uma transição justa. Perfil desejado: - Mestrado completo em Economia, Ciência Política, Relações Internacionais, Políticas Públicas ou afins; - Excelente domínio de inglês, com capacidade comprovada de redação acadêmica; - Experiência em pesquisa nas áreas de transição energética, financiamento, desenvolvimento ou afins; - Experiência commétodos qualitativos de pesquisa, incluindo entrevistas e análise de dados; - Capacidade de conduzir pesquisa de forma autônoma, com rigor analítico e clareza na escrita. Atividades: - Revisão e sistematização de bibliografia acadêmica e de policy; - Estruturação, condução e análise de entrevistas com stakeholders relevantes; - Coleta e análise de dados qualitativos; - Redação de artigos acadêmicos e relatórios de pesquisa em português e inglês; - Contribuição para o desenvolvimento de produtos de pesquisa do CEFD. Condições: - Contrato de consultoria (a definir conforme o perfil); - Trabalho remoto, preferencialmente baseado no Brasil ou em fuso horário compatível; - Duração inicialde 6 meses, com possibilidade de extensão. Como se candidatar: Pessoas interessadas devem enviar e-mail com o título “Candidatura Pesquisador(a) Associado(a)- (nome completo)" para com os seguintes documentos: 1. Currículo atualizado; 2. Carta de motivação (até 500 palavras) destacando experiências relevantes; 3. Amostra de escrita acadêmica (em inglês ou português).

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Eko Truck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Sua missão: Garantir a correta apuração e cumprimento das obrigações fiscais da empresa. Assegurando conformidade com a legislação tributária vigente. Redução de riscos fiscais e suporte estratégico às áreas internas, por meio de análises, controles. Acompanhamento das rotinas tributárias e acessórias. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis. Sólidos conhecimentos fiscais: fechamento fiscal, retenção e apuração de impostos indiretos (estaduais) IPI, INSS, ICMS, ISS, PIS e COFINS. Conhecimentos em EFD e SPED Fiscal. title: Lp partnership manager (latam)
description:
We are looking for anLP Partnership Manager (LATAM)to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.Key Responsibilities:
Business Development & Partnerships
Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties
Market & Network Development
Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development
Execution & Collaboration
Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM
Banking & Infrastructure Setup
Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities
Requirements
5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferredVision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.
The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.

description: Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives? Must be available to teach 1 or 2 hours per week on a Wednesday 1pm – 6pm AEST (Brisbane timezone). Must be available to teach in the Australian/ New Zealand timezone, we have a lot of demand for this space so hours can be flexible. Job Summary Join our global team as an online teacher for Pre‑IGCSE Science and immerse yourself in a premium one‑on‑one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver Pre‑IGCSE Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching. Key Responsibilities Deliver personalized, high‑quality instruction in a one‑on‑one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs. Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment. Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes. Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines. Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience. Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth. Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library. Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access. Required Qualifications A minimum of 5 years of teaching at this level in a school setting. Please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement. A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching. Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team. Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods. Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A‑Levels curricula and examinations. Preferred Qualifications Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license. Online teaching experience. About Crimson Global Academy CGA is a world‑class online school delivering live, real‑time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures. We Are Doing This By Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age. If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one‑on‑one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning, apply now! To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Chief operating officer (coo)
description: In Planet is a mission-driven, remote-first Climate Tech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.Check out our Culture page here. About the Role Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including: Head of Operations and project deployment teams Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams Close collaboration with the VP of Science Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams About In Planet In Planet is a Climate Tech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights. About the Role Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)Language Skills: Portuguese, EnglishStart Date: Q3/4 2025We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact. Key Responsibilities Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader. Design and execute scalable ERW deployment operations in Brazil. Translate climate goals into operational strategies. Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance. Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders. Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders. Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder. Ensure compliance with standards and regulations. Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows. Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment. Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact. Team & Culture Building Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture. Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally. Promote a culture of collaboration and impact. Empower regional managers and technical leads. Ideal Candidate Profile Core Skills & Experience 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts. Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems. Fluent in Portuguese and English. Key Qualities Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency. Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership. Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth. Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed. Passion for sustainability and climate innovation. Bonus Points Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture. Deep network in Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining. Experience building strategic partnerships in Brazil. Experience developing and scaling agricultural tech. Our Values Trust: Promote transparency and kindness. Drive: Take action with urgency and purpose. Impact: Aim to make a meaningful global difference. Benefits Competitive salary and transparent expectations. Share options to foster ownership. Home office budget, hybrid remote work (around São Paulo). Personal development and language allowances. 40 days of annual leave. Autonomy to innovate and impact. Bi-annual team offsites in Brazil. Equipment such as laptops. Compensation Philosophy We ensure fair, equitable pay across regions, considering location, skills, and market conditions, with transparent ranges and adjustments to maintain competitiveness and fairness. Application Process Approximately 8 hours over 4-6 weeks, including multiple interviews, references, and profiling. Follow us on Linked In and subscribe to our newsletter for updates. title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)

In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions.   • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!
